backup_target: ZERO by default; one optional private fallback only when primary fails source rights or clarity
gates: Subject: exact canonical physical object only. If a paten is requested, a chalice may not appear in the published hero photo.
No unrelated liturgical vessels, tools, hands, museum labels or surrounding display objects competing with the subject. Minor display supports are separately noted, not automatically approved.
Plain neutral/dark background strongly preferred. Visible edges, complete silhouette, natural light, sharpness and true material colour.
Catholic traditional Roman-rite identification checked; do not substitute Byzantine or Protestant, generic unlabeled linens or viaticum accessories.
Full image must portray the object itself, not an action or grouping unless canonical ID explicitly defines a matched set or scene.
Original file rights, photographer, exact Commons source and licence tracked. Photographic crop/derivative must retain original provenance and respect licence; never invent visual evidence.
One provisional assistant choice does not confer user aesthetic approval, liturgical certification or publication rights approval.
If no source satisfies the gate, leave the hero empty and retain a precise acquisition instruction rather than publishing the best bad option.
exceptions: AL07 intentionally six matching candlesticks as one canonical set
AL16 three altar cards as one canonical set
AL17/AL18 are directional annotations on an authenticated altar image, not separate objects

selections.label: Altar bell
selections.background: subdued brown-black museum display; soft-focus exhibits and reflective glass shelf remain visible
selections.selection_rationale: One complete nineteenth-century Roman Catholic altar bell with handle, gilt enamelled body and base unobstructed; isolated subject dominates frame. Photographer's complete 4000x6000 original visually checked, enamel edges legible at 100% scale. The glass-case background contains soft-focus unrelated exhibits and is not a neutral studio image; therefore assistant-provisional only.
selections.qa_outstanding: Museological backdrop with bright blurred label and glass reflection; moderate original-image noise and slight softness. Source image must be appropriately credited under CC BY-SA 4.0; human aesthetic rating and independent liturgical editorial signoff outstanding.
